title: Display-removal / enclosure tamper on PC13 (TAMP_IN1) plus a no-cavity, glued, tamper-evident enclosure around the panel flex
threat: Physical interposition on the display flex (the Ledger implant was a concealed board behind the screen) and screen replacement with a fake panel (pq1's accepted post-boot fake-screen residual). pq1's TAMP driver handles internal tampers only; the external case-switch/mesh item is 'board not started'.
proposal: EVT: wire a continuity loop through the panel flex and a case-open switch to PC13 (one of the three free bonded pins and the U585's TAMP_IN1 — confirm against the pin table) with the hardware pull + RC filter `hardware_requirements.md` already specifies; firmware: enable the external tamper in `TAMP_CR1`/`CR2` in confirmed mode so the BHK backup registers erase on open (as internal tampers already do) and the device wipes/refuses the wizard. Mechanically: potted/glued display stack with no void behind the panel, ultrasonically welded case, serialised tamper-evident seal recorded at the factory ceremony and checked in the box-opening ceremony. Document the Coldcard clear-case / visible-circuit alternative as the open-inspection option.
rationale: Passport Prime ships 'factory reset on any attempt to remove the screen'; Coldcard ships a visible-circuit clear case; Ledger's only answer is photos. The implant needs physical volume and flex access; denying both is the one measure that scales to adaptive implants that D-02/D-03 cannot resolve.
repo_evidence: secure/src/hw/tamp.rs:194-198, 288, 313 (ITAMP1/2/3/5/6 only — no TAMP_INx external tamper enable)
docs/hardware/hardware_requirements.md:107-108, 240 (case switch -> TAMP_INx 'board not started'; pin enable is the missing firmware piece)
README.md:459 (tamper-evident packaging is an unchecked production checklist item)
vendor_precedent: Foundation Passport Prime (screen-removal/PCB/chassis tamper -> irreversible factory reset); Coldcard Mk4 clear case + SE-driven genuine LED; Trezor TAMP all-internal-confirmed mode (core/embed/sec/tamper/stm32u5/tamper.c). Ledger: none (procedural only).
risks: External tamper on the backup domain must survive power-off (needs VBAT path — pq1 has no battery, so the 'open while unpowered' case only wipes on next power-up when the loop reads open; state that). Glued stacks hurt repairability (accepted for a signer). Mechanical no-cavity design is a product decision outside this repo; mis-wired TAMP_IN wipes units in the field — needs the TAMP_FLTCR filter and a bench receipt.
